facts.fact: Ted 逼走条款生效：为了 Bailey 的安全他必须走
facts.anchor: If this is the only way I can keep Bailey safe, I have to go.

facts.fact: 他给 Nate 打电话：答应 Stingers——几天内飞
facts.anchor: Tell them it’s a yes. I’ll fly out in a couple of days.”

facts.fact: 离别礼物：他付评估费（提前走欠她的工资）
facts.anchor: I can pay for your assessments because I’ve got money coming in. It’ll be my leaving gift.

facts.fact: 她怕自己「只是难搞」——他正名：我爱你的一切
facts.anchor: “Never call yourself that. You’re incredible. I love who you are, every last part of you.”

facts.fact: 她承认感受但说不出：因为改变、怕被拒绝、因为「我是我」
facts.anchor: I can’t say it yet. Not because I don’t feel it

facts.fact: 他禁止她道歉：你是让我爱上 Bailey 身边的人、让我爱上你的一切
facts.anchor: Don’t ever apologise for being you
